mapper.select: SELECT id, place_id, day_date, place_name, category, starts_at, duration_minutes, note, sort_order, estimated_cost, completed FROM trip_stops WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trips WHERE id=#{tripId} AND user_id=#{userId}) ORDER BY day_date, sort_order, starts_at

SELECT id, user_id, name, destination, starts_on, ends_on, status, notes, preferences FROM trips WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY starts_on NULLS LAST, created_at DESC LIMIT 500
SELECT id, user_id, name, destination, starts_on, ends_on, status, notes, preferences FROM trips WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trips (id, user_id, name, destination, starts_on, ends_on, notes, status, preferences) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{request.name}, #{request.destination}, #{request.startsOn}, #{request.endsOn}, COALESCE(#{request.notes}, ''), COALESCE(#{request.status},'planning'), COALESCE(#{request.preferences,jdbcType=OTHER,typeHandler=com.travelatlas.common.TripPreferencesTypeHandler},'{}'::jsonb))
mapper.update: UPDATE trips SET name = #{request.name}, destination = #{request.destination}, starts_on = #{request.startsOn}, ends_on = #{request.endsOn}, notes = COALESCE(#{request.notes}, ''), status=COALESCE(#{request.status},status), preferences=COALESCE(#{request.preferences,jdbcType=OTHER,typeHandler=com.travelatlas.common.TripPreferencesTypeHandler},preferences), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE trip_stops SET day_date=day_date + #{days}::integer, updated_at=now() WHERE trip_id=#{id} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trips WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL)
UPDATE trips SET deleted_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM trip_stops WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trips WHERE id=#{tripId} AND user_id=#{userId})
